summary: Frontend E2E (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080) of number quick actions (Call/Text/Fax) and the toll-free texting verification flow (customer form → admin approve/file → Mark active → switch texting on). Every requested flow worked as specified. Found 1 functional bug: after toll-free verification is active and texting is on, the number page still says 'Limited texting … US mobile carriers need business texting approval (10DLC)'. Also found 3 minor UX/design issues.

minor.issue: There is no status check on 'activate', so a 'submitted' row can go straight to active without being filed, and so can a 'rejected' one. The admin UI also shows 'Mark active' on submitted rows.
An active verification can be rejected, but texting stays on if it was already switched on. canText is only checked when texting is switched on.

US numbers count as 'approval needed' unless f.tenDlc or P2P is set. A toll-free number whose tollFreeVerify status is active (or that MultiTEL shows as verified) still gets 'US mobile carriers need business texting approval (10DLC)'.

ui_bugs.component: Number detail header ReachChip (+13341112222 after TFV active + texting on)
ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'Limited texting · can text 4 countries' and the 10DLC note 'US mobile carriers need business texting approval (10DLC) for this number first'. This is wrong and confusing for a verified toll-free number. The root cause is in the backend sms-rules (see above).

issues: On cards that show Add number + copy + call + text icons, the 'Open' button sticks out about 12px past the right edge of the card (e.g. cards 0, 2 and 3). The footer row needs to wrap or shrink.

design_issues.screen: Text icon on an unverified toll-free number
issues: The confirm dialog offers 'Turn on texting? $0.05 per text', which then always fails with the toll-free verification error. Since n.features.texting.mode === 'tollfree' is known, it would be better to skip the price confirm and go straight to the Texting tab with an info toast.
The last nav item is cut off ('Clouc…') and runs into the admin email at 1920px width.

action_items: Fix sms-rules / sms-reach so a toll-free US/CA number whose tollFreeVerify status is active (or carrierVerified) is treated as approved, not as needing 10DLC.
Only allow 'activate' from 'filed' (or hide 'Mark active' on submitted rows), or confirm that skipping the filing step is intended.
Decide what rejecting an active TFV should do to texting that is already on (turn it off?).
Make the number-card footer fit inside the card (the Open button overflows when 3 icons show).
NumberActions.text(): when mode === 'tollfree' and not verified, skip the price confirm and go straight to ?tab=sms.
Optional: after the TFV PUT succeeds, refresh the form state from the response so the state field shows the normalised 'TX' (it shows 'tx' until reload).
critical_code_review_comments: NumberActions: canCall shows the Call icon on +447860089499 even though that card has no 'Calls' capability badge. Check whether access.browserPhone is meant to override the capability badges.

Softphone autoLine effect works when the panel is already open and the line is switched (tested). connect() is skipped for mobile/non-browserPhone numbers, so the auto-connect does nothing there, which is fine.

tollfree.js canText: `(d?.status==='active' && ...) || carrierVerified(phone)` returns a Promise inside an async function. This works, but carrierVerified makes a MultiTEL network call on every switch-on attempt and on every GET for numbers that are not active.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed; 1 display bug (10DLC note on verified toll-free)
